source.title: Name-first original Dragonflight ranked prospecting and milling raw-cast search

notes: Eight distinct source domains checked, original cohort provenance reconciled against queue and prior evidence. No previously unindexed completed-operation material 0/1/2+ histogram; did not treat nominal ore, resourcefulness refunds or item totals as cast/hit counts.
lookingFor: Draconium, Serevite, Khaz'gorite, Prismatic prospecting and Bubble Poppy/Saxifrage milling original output-specific per-completed-operation hit and zero histograms
whereLooked: reddit.com/r/woweconomy: name-first original Draconium Ore Serevite Ore gem-by-completed-prospect logs; 108782r, 109bytz, 10i63zb and 10u5ao8 already indexed; nominal ore/refunds not verified casts
reddit.com/r/woweconomy: Khaz'gorite Ore and Prismatic Ore source-original 0/1/2+ diamond and Eternity Amber per-output results; 10h6ccx and superbondez already indexed
wowhead.com: named Dragon Isles Prospecting original gem comments, Serevite ore rank, Prismatic Ore original reports and Saxifrage Blazing Pigment Aary study; no new original 0-N output histograms
us.forums.blizzard.com: named Bubble Poppy and Saxifrage first-person milling-by-cast result searches; no unindexed pigment cast ledger
warcraft.wiki.gg: Prismatic Ore Dragonflight prospect/ore/herb identity and operation notes; reference facts but no firsthand zero-inclusive sample
wow-professions.com: Dragon Isles named Jewelcrafting/Inscription prospect/mill source tables and batch sizes; no new source-original per-cast material histograms
method.gg: Dragonflight named herb-to-pigment milling mapping guides; output family reference only
github.com: named Dragonflight ProspectMate/CraftSim Draconium or Serevite ore raw operation export; no independently published character-specific full per-cast 0-N ledger
